title: GLIDE-SPEC 40 Unified Solid Stick Prior Schema
description: Unified 35-variable schema linking formulation composition, physical process history, multimodal rheology, and mechanical QC responses across public benchmarks and physical pilot batches.

source_id.description: Identifier for source publication or patent

formulation_id.description: Identifier for specific formulation or batch

filler_fraction.description: Mass fraction of inorganic/organic particulate powders (0.0 - 1.0)

cooling_rate.description: Controlled cooling rate during solidification in °C/min

heating_rate.description: Heating rate during thermal ramp in °C/min

frequency.description: Oscillatory frequency in Hz or rad/s

time.description: Transient test duration or relaxation time in seconds

tan_delta.description: Loss factor tan delta = G'' / G'

hardness.description: Peak 3-point bending breaking force in gf or N

stiffness.description: Elastic resistance gradient in N/mm or gf/mm

payoff.description: Transferred mass per stroke in mg or g

gel_temperature.description: Gelation onset or G'=G'' crossover temperature in °C

aging_time.description: Storage duration in days or weeks

measurement_method.description: Standard test method (e.g. SAOS, LAOS, ASTM D1321, 3-point bend)

source_url.description: URL to canonical article or repository
